title: The Echo Master's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the primers that adds the exact counterpart and a break that ends the counterpart in a blow.

title: A Treatise on the Hollow Retinue
summary: A treatise on filling a field with hollow figures that march at the student's word and collapse on it all at once.

title: The Azure Twin Likeness Course
summary: A course of the azure sky that casts a twin likeness bright enough to be mistaken for the student and strong enough to guard.

title: Manual of the Skyward Shade
summary: A manual that lofts a shade high above the student on a rising line of soul force and lets it strike from above.

title: The Gale-Borne Phantom Canon
summary: A canon of the gale that rides phantoms on fast wind-like surges of soul force and scatters them at the moment of contact.

title: A Wind-Sworn Wraith Course
summary: A short oath-course that binds a wraith to the student's spoken word and teaches how to hold a fallen ally's soul steady.
